title: Farmers Market Vendor Tracking Log
subtitle: Farmers Market Vendor Operation: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Farmers Market Vendor Tracking Log covers vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout. The market vendor coordinator records Farmers Market Vendor Operation events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Farmers Market Vendor Tracking Log keeps Farmers Market Vendor Operation exceptions visible until the market vendor coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Farmers Market Vendor Tracking Log at market, booth, vehicle, storage cooler, display, and customer service area. Document vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout identity before Farmers Market Vendor Operation begins. Compare vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout findings with stated Farmers Market Vendor Operation criteria; route unresolved Farmers Market Vendor Operation issues to market operations or food-safety reviewer. For Farmers Market Vendor Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Farmers Market Vendor Operation. Ask market operations or food-safety reviewer to review Farmers Market Vendor Operation conditions beyond the market vendor coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Farmers Market Vendor Operation, identify responsible parties, market, booth, vehicle, storage cooler, display, and customer service area, and the linked vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout source.

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Farmers Market Vendor Operation facts for vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Farmers Market Vendor Operation tracked controls
items: Label, price, allergen, and customer information

Unsold product, waste, complaint, and incident closeout

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Keep the Farmers Market Vendor Operation chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Market Vendor Coordinator, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Complaint or unsold product lacks disposition
blocks.guidance: Pause Farmers Market Vendor Operation when vendor authority, product trace, display control, complaint, or product disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Farmers Market Vendor Operation proof and route unresolved vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout scope to market vendor coordinator.
